Alive…. 🍫💔🥀 Sharing with you a little mini film moment I did inspired by a film I believe is underrated “ CHOCOLAT “ featuring amazing talents Juliette Binoche , Johnny Depp, Judi Dwight, Leslie Caron…  . It is a charming period drama set in a small village in France about belonging and living the life that is right for you. ♥️ There is just enough magical realism to give the story a fairy-tale like feel. It also helps that Chocolat is a visual treat and Johnny Depp is always great to look at! Haha  . .
